method: Only assign a voltage when the exact manufacturer configuration states it. A stated 220–240 V AC range is normalized to nominal 230 V; do not infer 400 V from heater power alone.
assignment_rules: A 230-V value requires an exact product or configuration page that states 230 V, a 220–240 V AC range, or steckerfertig for that model.
A 400-V value requires an exact product or configuration page or manual that states 400 V for that model.
Products sold without an oven or with a selectable oven remain voltage-neutral until a configuration is chosen.
An electric heater with a stated kW rating but no stated voltage remains voltage-neutral and carries an electrician check note.
